amended: Phase 2 (§2.3) added GET /api/health — node, link, hub, model and DB health in one object.
phase7_note: /assets/<path:asset> added in Phase 7 (§7.6). gis-map.js's header has claimed this route since v4.5.
phase8_note: Phase 8 (§8.3) added GET /api/alerts, GET /api/alerts/policy, POST /api/alerts/<id>/ack and GET /api/alerts/<id>/deliveries.
note: Phase 9 (B6) added POST /api/sync and GET /api/sync/status — §9.4's two routes. Recorded here on purpose, like Phase 2's /api/health.
phase10_note: Phase 10 (B13/B14) added GET /api/blackbox/status and GET /api/blackbox/chunks — the chunk ledger and the gate's per-chunk reasons. /api/blackbox/recover is Phase 11's and is deliberately absent rather than stubbed.
phase11_note: Phase 11 (B15) added POST /api/blackbox/recover — the manual half of the reconnect handshake and the REPLAY burst. It answers 409 (not 503) when there is no gateway: a command that cannot be carried out must not report success.
